claims.statement: VoxelCluster owns voxels keyed by cell coordinate and updates bounds and render data on each insertion or removal; removal deletes the voxel after erasing it from the cluster.
Damager applies component damage compensation, records dead voxels and their WorldObject modifications, and can skip impacts on the player ship through the playerShipUndestroyable property.
SplitDetector flood-fills occupied voxel groups after modifications, retaining the group with the crucial voxel or otherwise the largest group, and emits all other groups as split data.
Splitter creates a new WorldObject with cloned voxels for each split-off and removes the extracted source voxels.
